notes: Ludum Dare 53 game Return to Sender by hacktic / Matthew B (hacktic-dev). Complete Unity 2021.3.8f1 project with playable scene Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2023 Matthew B (hacktic)). Also listed at https://hacktic.itch.io/return-to-sender. Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (com.unity.feature.2d 1.0.0 and its 2D stack, TextMesh Pro 3.0.6 as a package not vendored into Assets, Timeline 1.6.4, uGUI, Visual Scripting 1.7.8, IDE packages, test framework, and built-in modules). The only declared third-party asset is the FontStruction Minimal5x7 by kheftel, Creative Commons Attribution 3.0, at Assets/Resources/minimal5x7.ttf (Assets/Resources/license.txt retained). Game art (letters, bags, notes, stamps) and short WAV SFX live under Assets/Resources/ with no other third-party license files. No DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained.
